finding: The current film is silent: the scene defines visual objects and animations only, and the rendered MP4 contains no audio stream. Background-noise reduction is therefore not measurable or applicable to this artifact.

candidate_change.scope: render/export QA only; production files unchanged
candidate_change.proposal: Add a gate that probes the rendered artifact before any denoise step. If no audio stream exists, record the axis as not-applicable and preserve the file. If an intentional audio stream is introduced later, compare a declared quiet reference segment with the program segment before and after denoise, and accept only a result with a lower measured noise floor and no declared speech/transient regression.

evidence.observation: The scene imports JSON, pathlib, NumPy, and Manim, reads the canonical snapshot, sets the visual camera background, and contains no audio/sound/music/ambient/noise setup.

ffprobe reports nb_streams=1 with only a video stream: H.264, 854x480, 172 frames, duration 11.466016 seconds. The audio-stream probe returns an empty streams list. SHA-256: 77a364129f1409a4b11a0e861c477f374a815e4a4b49174c5d5747d64aa6a153.
The canonical source forbids encrypted reasoning, raw thoughts, credentials, environment secrets, and prompt content; its fake_evidence flag is false. No such material is used in this proposal.

falsifier: This finding is falsified if a hash-identified future render of WorldBoundAgentsV1 contains an intentional audio stream, or if an independently reproduced render contains audio that can be segmented into a quiet reference and program interval. In that case, measure the noise floor and speech/transient preservation instead of treating the axis as not-applicable.
next_measurement: Run ffprobe -v error -select_streams a -show_entries stream=index,codec_name,channels,sample_rate,duration -of json on the candidate render. If audio exists, record pre/post RMS or LUFS for a declared quiet reference segment and program segment, plus a speech/transient preservation check; if audio is absent, retain an explicit not-applicable result.
